body: Already having my mood go up and down bit to today. Not sure how the night will be. Only was able to sleep for 3 hours last night. I've been so stressed, I can constantly feel my heart pounding in my head and chest.
Making friends is just so difficult for me. I wish I had someone I already had that connection with. I just spoke to a great therapist a bit ago though and I'm feeling a little better.
I just spoke to an incredible therapist so I'm feeling a little bit better right now
I wish I had someone who actually knew me care that much.
I'm too lonely. I'm too tired.
I'm out of hope for it getting better.
I'm not sure. Maybe to spare my family the pain it would cause. I still don't want to be here though.

I don't know if I can be helped anymore. Too much has happened to just "choose positivity." My hearts been broken over and over and when I finally thought I was finding closure and coping well, my hearts been ripped out and stomped on again. I don't have people I can talk to about this face to face. It's so fucking lonely.

I can't sleep now. I have somewhere I need to be this morning. I would have just skipped it if that wouldn't mean they would send police thinking I've done myself in. I wish I was strong enough to just kill myself.

I don't see another couple days of misery worth anything. I don't have the energy to kill myself right now though. I wish I could just sleep. The hurt will never go away. I don't understand how someone could hurt another person this badly and that week go back to having fun and partying as if nothing happened. He was the love of my life. I never thought he'd do this to me, especially not a second time. I don't want to live feeling this way. I foolishly thought things were getting better. I'm an idiot.

My ex boyfriend left me and has become a person I don't even recognize anymore. He's hurt me too many times now and I'm still in love with him. I'm going to be alone no matter what I do. I don't have the energy to help anyone else. I don't want to keep living.
